page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring moderate graphical or parallel computing capabilities. It features an Intel Xeon 8369B processor with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 62.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB per core. For acceleration, it includes a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU with an allocation of 0.3333 and 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average range for its hardware class. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a single-core stress-ng score of 1897.68 and a multi-core score of 28616.81, while the Geekbench multi-core score reaches 12885.0. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block bandwidth of 1617.72 GB/sec and a large block write bandwidth of 28.19 GB/sec. In terms of specialized workloads, the instance handles LLM inference for a small 135M model at 1278.81 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 258.41 tokens/sec for text generation, though performance drops to 32.87 tokens/sec prompt processing for a medium 7B model.

By utilizing a fractional GPU configuration, the ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8.4xlarge offers a cost-efficient alternative to full-GPU instances, allowing users to access hardware acceleration for lighter graphics, ray tracing, or image processing tasks without the expense of a dedicated physical card. The absence of local storage requires external block storage integration. This instance is suited for entry-level AI inference, lightweight 3D rendering, image processing, and general-purpose workloads that benefit from GPU assistance.
